Recaps understand flowcharts: boards' flowcharts are read as algorithms (IF/REPEAT/units/calls) and the recap prompt explains what each computes. Verified on the 13 real draw.io boards locally; CI green; self-reviewed.

AI reconstruction now works on real Miro screenshots: vocabulary sent as a validated tool schema (structured outputs rejected it as too large), and AI text/labels are sized to fit. First real run: 2 requests, $0.37. CI green; self-reviewed.

Exact draw.io import (no AI) and a Miro-oriented AI scene vocabulary for the real lesson boards. Verified on all 13 real draw.io boards (rendered and inspected) and the mock AI board; CI green (api, web, docs, images). Self-reviewed.

Run the production Docker stack locally (deploy/local.env, http://localhost:8080) and keep Deploy and AI review workflows off until DEPLOY_ENABLED / AI_REVIEW_ENABLED are set. Verified with a full local docker compose run; CI green (api, web, docs, images). Self-reviewed.
